sources.snippet: 🦙💡 Pretraining a LLaMA-3-like Model on TinyStories with PyTorch Welcome to this project where we dive into the fascinating world of pretraining a LLaMA 3-like transformer model using the TinyStories dataset. I build everything with the help of PyTorch and associated libraries, focusing on clarity, scalability, and performance.

sources.snippet: 🧸 TinyStories LLM - A Miniature Language Model for Storytelling A 40M parameter decoder-only transformer trained on the TinyStories dataset, designed to generate short, coherent children's stories. Inspired by the Mistral architecture, built and trained from scratch by a self-taught student exploring large language models.
